interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Agentic Vault keeps plain-Markdown Obsidian memory, budgeted SessionStart handoffs, source-attributed recall, fail-closed git gates and verified backups shared across Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLI. Release v0.60.0 adds three Python stdlib-only security, policy-integrity, and lifecycle-propagation improvements: extends linear-time SessionStart and vault_doctor hidden markup sanitization (_strip_hidden_markup, arXiv:2602.10498) to strip Obsidian %% ... %% comments, zero-dimension <svg>, and <svg>-scoped <desc>/<title>/<metadata> in the injected buffer only (preserving fenced code, inline code spans, single %, and plain prose); adds the opt-in read-only content-free operator deny-rule monotonicity and hook script SHA-256 drift auditor (skills/agentic-vault/scripts/vault_policy_drift.py, docs/policy-drift.md, vault_doctor --policy-drift; grounded in arXiv:2611.32195 and arXiv:2611.01976); and propagates v0.59.0 status: withdrawn and superseded metadata non-breakingly into vault_retrieval.py (lifecycle_status annotations, --as-of exclusion, opt-in --exclude-withdrawn and --exclude-superseded; grounded in arXiv:2605.14478 and ccf/agentcairn) and vault_healthcheck.py (opt-in --exclude-retired and exclude_retired_from_active_checks). Retained from v0.59.0: vault_lifecycle.py, exact verification-bundle tree membership in scripts/verify_release_claims.py, coverage spec/review separation, 14 commands, 15 Antigravity CLI skills, and 1 Codex required skill. No new runtime dependencies; Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime; publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults. The seven certificate-bound checker files remain byte-identical from v0.55.0 through v0.60.0; when upgrading from v0.54.1 or earlier where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
